viceChancellor.name: Prof. Dr. A B M Shawkat Ali
viceChancellor.title: Vice-Chancellor
viceChancellor.university: Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT)
viceChancellor.academicRole: Professor, Department of Data Science & Engineering
viceChancellor.office: Office of the Vice-Chancellor, Building 1, BUBT Permanent Campus, Rupnagar, Mirpur-2, Dhaka
viceChancellor.message: Welcome to BUBT. Our mission is to produce world-class graduates equipped with high technical competency, analytical mindset, and ethical leadership to serve the nation and the global society.
viceChancellor.bio: Prof. Dr. A B M Shawkat Ali assumed the role of Vice-Chancellor of BUBT on October 1, 2024. Prior to joining BUBT, he served as a professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at The University of Fiji. He is an internationally acclaimed computer scientist, academician, and researcher with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Big Data.
